snippet.title: Eclipse Breaker Trailer | Demo Out Now! | Strategic Action Roguelike Inspired by '90s JRPGs
snippet.description:
Step into the time-warped world of Eclipse Breaker, a fast-paced strategic roguelike reborn from the golden age of PlayStation classics. Inspired by 90s JRPGs but built for today's roguelike fans, Eclipse Breaker delivers tight gameplay, replayable runs, and an unforgettable aesthetic throwback.

⚔️ Battle your way through procedurally generated enemies
⏱️ Master a modernized Active Time Battle (ATB)-inspired system
🌀 Push forward with every run in this high-stakes roguelike revival

💾 Play the FREE demo now on Steam
🛒 Wishlist Eclipse Breaker to support the launch!

🎮 Old-school feel. New-school gameplay.
Get in. Break the loop. Become the legend.

👉 Play the demo & wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2815060/Eclipse_Breaker/

Eclipse Breaker will be coming to Steam in 2025.

#EclipseBreaker #Roguelike #IndieGame #PS1Style #IndieDev #SteamDemo #GamingTrailer #RetroRevival #ATBCombat
